title: Understanding Residuals
text: The residual vector e represents the difference between the observed values Y and the predicted values hat{Y}. Think about what this means for the dimensions of e compared to Y.

title: Dimensions of Vectors
text: Consider the dimensions of the parameter vector hat{theta}. How many parameters are there in the model $$hat{s}=\theta_0+\theta_1 h+\theta_2 t$$?

title: Comparing Dimensions
text: Which of the following statements is true about the dimensions of the residual vector e and the parameter vector hat{theta}?
choices: The parameter vector hat{theta} is a scalar.
The residual vector e has a different dimension than the parameter vector hat{theta}.
The residual vector e has the same dimension as the parameter vector hat{theta}.
The residual vector e is a scalar.
